summary: Sunhee Kim completed a PhD in Performance Practice at the University of Exeter under doctoral supervisor Phillip B. Zarrilli (attested 2013).

Linguist and Indologist Suniti Kumar Chatterji studied at Scottish Church College, Presidency University, University of Calcutta, University of London under Lionel David Barnett, and Paris under Jules Bloch. He was a professor at the University of Calcutta and National Professor in Humanities.
Indologist Sunny Kumar earned a Ph.D. from Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University (2013–2015). In 2016, he served as an assistant professor at Gorakshanath Government Sanskrit College.
Supree Kanjanapisarn works in religious studies and philosophy. He completed a PhD at Assumption University under the supervision of Veerachart Nimanong (attested 2011).
Surabhi Verma, an Indology and philosophy scholar, earned a Ph.D. from Panjab University (2012–2015). In 2015, she was appointed assistant professor at the National Institute of Technology Rourkela.

Surama Dasgupta was an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied under Surendranath Dasgupta, earned degrees from the University of Calcutta, and completed a Ph.D. at the University of Cambridge in 1948. She served as Reader at the University of Lucknow.
Suren Naicker is a scholar of linguistics, Indology, and religious studies. He earned a D Litt et Phil from the University of South Africa, where he also held a post.
Surendra Man Bajracharya is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed a PhD at Tribhuvan University under doctoral supervisor Bhadra Ratna Bajracharya and co-supervisor Ranjana Bajracharya.

Indologist and philosopher Surendranath Dasgupta studied at Surendranath College, Sanskrit College and University, University of Calcutta, and University of Cambridge under J. M. E. McTaggart and James Ward. He held posts at Cambridge, Presidency University, Sanskrit College, and University of Calcutta.
Surendranath Majumdar Sastri was an Indology and history scholar who studied under traditional teacher Hara Prasad Sastri. He served as a Reader at Patna University (attested 1924).
Indology and philosophy scholar Suresha R. held a post at the University of Mysore in 2013 and served as an assistant professor at Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute (attested 2026).
Surya Das is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at the University at Buffalo (1968–1971) and under traditional teacher Nyoshul Khenpo Rinpoche (~1984–1997).

Surya Kanta was an Indologist and linguist who studied under Frederick William Thomas and completed a D.Phil. at the University of Oxford in 1937. He served as Reader in Sanskrit at the University of the Punjab (attested 1939).

Surya Tahora studied at Aix-Marseille University, INSEAD, Paris-Sud University, and Arsha Vidya Gurukulam. Working in philosophy and Indology, he became Executive Director at the S. P. Jain Institute of Management and Research in 2021.

Historian and Indologist Suryakumar Bhuyan studied at Cotton University, Presidency University, University of Calcutta, and SOAS University of London. He served as Principal of Cotton University and Vice Chancellor of Gauhati University (~1957–1960).

Suryanarayana Shukla studied at Rajgopal Sanskrit Mahavidyalaya under Nandakishore Pandey, Ramanujacharya, and Shridatta Pandey. Specializing in Indology, linguistics, and philosophy, he was a professor at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University (~1928–1944).

Buddhist studies and Sinology scholar Susan Andrews earned her PhD at Columbia University (attested 2013) under supervisor Chün-fang Yü, having also studied under Bernard Faure, David Max Moerman, Michael I. Como, Koichi Shinohara, and Phyllis Granoff.

Susan Hawthorne studied at Melbourne Teachers' College, La Trobe University, University of Melbourne, and Australian National University. Working in Indology and philosophy, she was appointed Adjunct Professor at James Cook University in 2018.

Susan J. Rosenfield is an Indology scholar who earned a PhD from Harvard University in 2004, studying under Stephanie W. Jamison, George L. Hart, Kausalya Hart, Shaligram Shukla, Saudamani Deshmukh, James W. Benson, and Thomas Burke.
Susan L. Beningson is a scholar of Sinology, history and archaeology, and Buddhist studies. She earned her PhD at Columbia University under the supervision of Robert E. Harrist, Jr. (attested 2009).
